bull_bear.body:
- "During the quarter, we successfully concluded our recent share buyback program", which the CEO frames as reflecting "the strength of our balance sheet, the Board's disciplined approach to capital allocation, and its confidence in the Company's intrinsic value and long-term prospects."
- Paid up equity share capital (face value Rs.10 per share) is shown at Rs 302.81 million as at 30-Jun-26 versus Rs 311.31 million at both 31-Mar-26 and 30-Jun-25.
- States "ongoing investment in the capabilities that compound over time - deep engineering talent, AI-led transformation, and modern cloud delivery".
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Describes itself as a CMMI Level 3 "next-generation Enterprise Cloud Transformations provider" and an Enterprise Multi-Cloud Transformation Services provider focused on Esri ArcGIS Enterprise cloud platforms, cloud-based SAP digitalized solutions and Spatialitics cloud-native SaaS.
- Explicitly rejects the commodity model: "CyberTech has never been a volume-based IT services firm; our model is built on engineering depth - precisely the capability that matters most as AI reshapes how enterprise technology is built, delivered, and consumed."
- The deck contradicts itself on Esri tier: the CEO commentary cites "our recognition as an Esri Platinum Partner - the highest tier in the Esri ecosystem", while the About section of the same document states CyberTech "is an Esri Gold Partner and SAP Gold Partner". Both readings are recorded as stated.
- Became an AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner during the quarter, adding to an established Microsoft Azure collaboration; partnership set listed as Esri, SAP, Microsoft, AWS and Cisco.
- In SAP S/4HANA and Business Technology Platform (BTP), works closely with the SAP Migration Factory to move clients to SAP cloud; describes an "AI-first operating approach, embedded across delivery and products".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Footprint] Locations are USA (Chicago, Philadelphia, Aurora, Redlands) and India (Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata); the company "owns a state-of-the-art development center at Thane", which is also its registered office ('CyberTech House', MIDC Wagle Estate, Thane).
- [Founding date conflict] The About section says the company was "Founded in 1995" (CIN also reads MH1995), while the CEO's bio states he "Co-founded the company in 1990". Both are quoted as the deck does not reconcile them.
- [Leadership] Vish Tadimety is Chairman and CEO (co-founded Corliant in 2007 with a Cisco partnership, later acquired by Accenture); Steven Jeske has been Group CFO since 1999 and is a Corliant co-founder; Ramasubramanian S. is Executive Director heading global operations.
- [Ecosystem] Served again as a Bronze Sponsor at the Esri User Conference during the quarter, described as deepening engagement with the global geospatial community.
- [Corporate timeline] Deck timeline: 2009 - Vish took over control of the company and GeoSpatial became the main focus area; 2010-13 Geo focus / exceptional talent; 2015-16 incubate Geo 2.0 products; 2016-17 advisory board formed with industry leaders; 2017-18 Spatialitics formed.
